verdict: key consistent: 67 signs = 67 letters, 17 groups = 17 words, one letter per shape, with the cipher's forms قلبي, بنجواك, يخبرني; homophones ي (S4, S18), ن (S5, S21), ل (S2, S14)
notes: Rows 2v l.3-7 on image 0084_0009 (segmenter line 2 is naskh 'فيهما غاية الصدق', not cipher). Signs per row 17,14,13,13,10 = 67 (record 16,14,14,13,11 = 68); dividers 3,5,3,4,2 = 17 (record 17). Three words differ from the record: (1) first group has 4 signs, ring-angle-٢-ط = ق ل ب ي: the word is قلبي, not لبي (the ل S2 and ب S3 recur in فلا/تكلف and بما); (2) second group has 6 signs ب ن ج و ا ك: بنجواك, not بجواك (U = ن as in عنك, اني; looped Λ = ا throughout); (3) the fifth group starts with S4, which is ي in قلبي, ايضاح, اني, not ت (ت is S22 in تكلف, تدعيه, معترف): يخبرني, which also agrees with the masculine شاهد. د (S12, cup head) and ص (S13, three teeth) and the two loop-headed ے (S21 ن smooth, S22 ت with a tooth) were separated at 3-4x. S14 is a rounded bracket where every other ل is the sharp angle S2; kept apart as a variant. The solver's note (ya fell first, then nun, then alif) is compatible: ا 8, ي 6, ف 6, ن 5 are the commonest letters. The compiler's remark on 3r l.1-3 about a dropped ta in 'al-tamanni' does not apply here (no such word in the verse).
